IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Simpson, P. Sullivan, Kessler, Campbell, Chase and Haigh

Bill.BriefDescription: Providing an excise tax exemption for new businesses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to excise tax exemptions for new businesses; addinga new section to chapter 82.04 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) This chapter does not apply to a new business during the firsttwelve months of operation of the business. (2) As used in this section: (a) "New business" means a business that obtains or is required toobtain a registration certificate under RCW 82.32.030 for the firsttime. "New business" also includes a branch location or other facilityestablished after the effective date of this section by an entity doingbusiness in this state; (b) "New business" does not include: (i) A business that has been restructured, reorganized, ortransferred, if the activities to be conducted after restructuring,reorganization, or transferral are substantially similar to theactivities previously conducted; or p. 1 HB 1193 (ii) A business that is substantially similar to a businesscurrently operated, or operated within the past five years, by the sameprincipals.
